method: Current Fortinet administration/configuration/new-features/release documentation drove topic selection. Every candidate was compared against the 366-record 30-day exclusion inventory and rejected if its mechanism substantially overlapped.

products.admin_scope: FortiOS 8.0 Administration Guide and TCP-AO CLI syntax; BGP key-chain and neighbor authentication object relationships.
FortiManager 8.0 New Features Guide; corresponding Task Monitor and Event Log administration sections; log-max-days range and disk-quota fallback.
FortiAnalyzer 8.0 New Features Guide; System NTP CLI and Chrony server/key-file requirements.

FortiSwitchOS 8.0 Administration Guide Backup section, What’s New page and release notes; device-specific backup signatures, same-device provenance/integrity verification and verify-config log/reject policy.
FortiAP/FortiWiFi 8.0 Configuration Guide; VAP eligibility, RADIUS attribute 27 and station verification.
FortiNAC 9.4 Administration Guide; authentication policy object pairing, ordered profile evaluation, grace/offline/reauth timers and policy debug.
FortiNAC-F 7.6.5 Microsoft Entra ID Authentication Cookbook; Local RADIUS TLS service, Entra application connector, EAP-TTLS/PAP and supplicant configuration; explicit no-MFA limitation.
FortiAuthenticator 8.0.2 Administration Guide and release notes; TACACS+ client objects, client groups, policy selection and REST API endpoints.
FortiPAM 1.9 Administration Guide; Entra application, Graph permission, Exchange service principal/mailbox access and approval-email CLI.
FortiSIEM 7.5.1 External Systems Configuration Guide and User Guide; Windows Agent certificate-store monitoring, template association and event types.
FortiSASE Feature Administration Guide 26.1.107; agent-based ZTNA private applications, range/CIDR/port list support, FortiClient version prerequisites and endpoint-profile binding.
FortiOS 8.0 SD-WAN administration documentation; remote SLA, member priorities, iBGP neighbor route-metric, MED propagation through hubs and external path selection.
